property_summary: For any caller, a successful single Collect(...) call on the correct contract always decreases that caller's Acc(...).balance by the requested amount (i.e. state update to reduce balance occurs only once after the external transfer); the mutant removing the require allows a reentrant callback that makes the same Collect body run twice before the balance is decremented, so after the call the balance is larger than expected (the mutant can fail the single-decrement property).
change_summary: Remove the require(!locked_) check from the nonReentrant_ modifier so reentrancy guard no longer prevents reentrant Collect calls, changing revert behavior under reentrancy.
